name: DC-DC step-up (boost) converters
summary: Small switching boards that raise a DC voltage: 3.7V to 5V, 12V to 19V and so on.
uses: USB 5V from a single lithium cell
Driving LED strings from low-voltage batteries
identify: Small boards with a coil, a chip, a diode and capacitors, sometimes with a blue trimmer. Inside power banks, USB lights, cameras, torches and laptop car adapters; modules are marked MT3608 or XL6009.
test: Feed a low voltage in and measure the output: it should be higher and steady. Turn the trimmer, if fitted, and watch the output change.
